note: The October (B0) layer chain, one step per J0 stage row (run_config.py --step NAME), cwd = the repo. Every argv is October's recorded invocation: pipeline/frames/cal2026-10/README.md run lines, the restake reports, frames_econ/build_report_econ920_2026-10.json, frames_run_report_chemmath_2026-09-23.json, frames_afar/afar_run_report.json, frames_variants/p3_full_variants_report_*.json, frames/assembly_2026-10.json and the build log of 2026-09-22/23 (not shipped); new required flags (F3/F5) carry October's values. Not steps (ruling 'What runs in J0'): run_caliber.py (its run-2 outputs are base inputs in _invalid_run2), fetch_star_id_supplement.py and fetch_patch_supplement.py (live API; their outputs are base inputs), run_cal_estimates.py (cells run through run_cells.py), afar_event_map.py (robustness), ledger_new_2026_10.py, the july / aug_fold restake variants. b0_chain_paths: every repo path the steps read, code and base data (a directory entry covers everything under it); a change to one after J0 forces a J0 rerun (gates.py link). M inputs (data/cal2026-10r1/) are not on the list. F20 (the new-star departure ledger) is out of scope: author ruling 2026-10-15, the paper prints no star-departure robustness.
